attributes.name: Theruk Nul
attributes.powers:
Theruk Nul is immune to the Mental and Poison traits.

Before you act, a random other character at your location buries a spell or weapon.

While you act, when you are dealt damage by Theruk Nul, discard cards from the top of your deck instead of your hand.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from; if you do not close the location, shuffle Theruk Nul into that location deck.

corrections.corrected_text: On the henchman Theruk Nul, change "While you act, when you would be dealt damage by Theruk Nul, discard that number of cards from the top of your deck instead of your hand" to "While you act, when you are dealt damage by Theruk Nul, discard cards from the top of your deck instead of your hand".
corrections.issue: If Theruk Nul would deal me damage, am I dealt the damage?
